Images:
  - [Image #0] The image is a meme comparing two tweets from the same user, "Defender" (@DefenderOfBasic), before and after using a tool to circumvent Twitter's link-sharing restrictions.
    
    To reproduce the meme, follow these steps:
    * Create a white background.
    * At the top, include a screenshot of a tweet labeled "BEFORE" with the user's information, a blue checkmark, and a link to "defenderofthebasic.substack.com/p/a-trick-to-d...".
    * Below the link, display the timestamp "2:46 PM · May 30, 2024".
    * Draw a thick black line separating the "BEFORE" and "AFTER" sections.
    * In the "AFTER" section, include another screenshot of a tweet from the same user, with the text "A trick to dissolve social anxiety: close your eyes".
    * The "AFTER" tweet should feature an image of an older man with long, white hair and a beard, with a caption at the bottom.
    * At the bottom of the image, include the text "From substack-proxy.glitch.me".
